title: All question types
notes: Template showing every supported question type. Only visible when the app is opened with ?demo=1.
Copy this file into data/exams/ (with a new id) as a starting point for another course.

questions.stem: Which of these variables are categorical? (choose every correct option)
questions.explanation: Eye colour and country are categories; height is quantitative.

questions.stem: A sample of $n=100$ has mean 50 and standard deviation 10. Give the bounds of the approximate 95% confidence interval (use $z^*=1.96$).
questions.instruction: Use a dot as decimal separator.

questions.stem: Explain in your own words what a p-value is.
questions.modelAnswer: The probability, computed assuming the null hypothesis is true, of getting a test statistic at least as extreme as the one observed. (1 point for 'assuming $H_0$ is true', 1 point for 'at least as extreme'.)
questions.explanation: A p-value is not the probability that $H_0$ is true.

questions.stem: Match each description to the sampling method.

prompts.text: A random sample from every subgroup
Everybody in a few randomly chosen groups

questions.explanation: Strata: sample within every group. Clusters: take whole groups.
